# Performalytic

> Performalytic is an enterprise data analytics, AI, and DevOps consulting firm headquartered in Chicago, IL with a global delivery center in Bhubaneswar, India. Trusted by 500+ enterprise clients with 800+ data professionals and 99.9% client satisfaction. We help organizations turn data into a competitive advantage.

## Services

- [Enterprise Solution Development](https://performalytic.com/enterprise-solution-development/): Data strategy, architecture, master data management, governance, and platform modernization
- [Advanced Analytics & AI](https://performalytic.com/advanced-analytics-ai/): Machine learning, generative AI, RAG systems, AI agents, predictive analytics, and responsible AI
- [BI Integration](https://performalytic.com/bi-integration/): Business intelligence implementation on Power BI, SAP, Snowflake, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric
- [Application Development & System Integration](https://performalytic.com/application-development-and-system-integration/): Custom application development, CI/CD automation, and system integration

## Products

- [4DAlert](https://4dalert.com): AI-powered data management platform by Performalytic — automated data reconciliation, data quality and observability, master data management and entity resolution, schema compare, CI/CD for data, and the Ask4D GenAI assistant. App and product site: https://4dalert.com
- [4DAlert product overview](https://performalytic.com/products/): Modules, integrations, and use cases on performalytic.com
- [Data ROI Calculator](https://performalytic.com/tools/data-roi-calculator/): Free interactive tool to estimate savings from better data

## Key Topics

- Data Reconciliation: Automated cross-system data comparison, exception-driven workflows, and reconciliation best practices
- Master Data Management: Entity resolution, golden record, MDM implementation patterns
- Data Quality: Data quality frameworks, AI-native data quality, observability
- Business Intelligence: BI platform comparison, analytics strategy, dashboard design
- AI & Machine Learning: RAG architecture, AI agents, responsible AI, generative AI
- DevOps: CI/CD for data, schema compare, pipeline automation

## Knowledge Hub

- [Knowledge Hub](https://performalytic.com/knowledge/): Free practical guides on enterprise data, with definitions and FAQs for each topic
- [Data Architecture & Engineering](https://performalytic.com/knowledge/data-architecture-engineering/): Designing scalable data platforms, pipelines, lakehouses, data modeling, and reconciliation built into the architecture
- [Business Intelligence & Analytics](https://performalytic.com/knowledge/business-intelligence-analytics/): BI strategy, semantic layers, dashboards people use, choosing an analytics platform, and AI in BI
- [AI & Machine Learning](https://performalytic.com/knowledge/ai-machine-learning/): Production AI: RAG architecture, AI agents, MLOps, and responsible AI governance
- [Data Governance & Quality](https://performalytic.com/knowledge/data-governance-quality/): Data governance, data quality frameworks, master data management (MDM), golden records, and AI-native data quality
- [Cloud Data Platforms](https://performalytic.com/knowledge/cloud-data-platforms/): Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, cloud migration, cost control, and multi-cloud data consistency
- [DataOps & DevOps](https://performalytic.com/knowledge/dataops-devops/): DataOps, CI/CD for data, schema compare, and automated data reconciliation
